modmenu.descriptionTranslation.back_on_t: Records 100% raw gameplay (including GUI) to MP4 via FFmpeg. Inspired by Flashback and Replay Mod, minus the editor.
back_on_track.config.title: Back On Track - Settings
back_on_track.config.fps.tooltip: Target frames per second for the output video.
back_on_track.config.codec.tooltip: FFmpeg encoder. libx264 is recommended for compatibility.
back_on_track.config.preset.tooltip: Faster presets use less CPU but produce larger files.
back_on_track.config.captureGui.tooltip: If enabled, the HUD and screens are recorded too (raw output).
back_on_track.config.audio.tooltip: Captures Minecraft audio. Disable if you record system audio externally.
back_on_track.config.voicechat.tooltip: If Simple Voice Chat is installed, mix in incoming voice audio.
back_on_track.config.ffmpegPath.tooltip: Path to ffmpeg binary. Leave 'ffmpeg' to use system PATH.
back_on_track.config.outputDir.tooltip: Folder where recordings are saved (relative to .minecraft).
back_on_track.config.showHud.tooltip: Show a REC indicator and timer while recording.
back_on_track.toast.start.title: Back On Track
back_on_track.toast.stop.title: Back On Track
back_on_track.toast.error.title: Back On Track - Error
back_on_track.toast.error.ffmpeg: FFmpeg not found. Set the path in settings or install FFmpeg.
